title: Packetwise mu-sign assignment attempt
interpretation: Projection-count parity gives a nonbalanced 6/18 mu-shadow, while a balanced 12/12 shadow can be imposed by orientation slot. Therefore the 12/12 carrier cannot be said to inherit mu-signs from the projection counts alone; an actual packetwise mu artifact is still required.
honesty_boundary: Sign-assignment attempt only; not computed Weyl mu transport over the 270 triples.
